page.overview:
Who is Gram?

Gram was one of the archaeologists of Ohara.

Gram was a young average sized girl, with short blond hair under a purple cap. She wore a coat that matched her hat, with a light blue shirt underneath that was darker blue at the collar, and had four white buttons.

Gram was a very devoted scholar who stayed behind to help ditch books into a lake in an effort to protect them. She, along with the other scholars, were friendly towards Nico Robin.

Gram was very close to Nico Olvia, who she considered like an older sister.
